verdict.rationale: The SDK provides building blocks for tracing: hooks fire on agent events such as tool calls, the message stream exposes assistant messages, session transcripts are written to disk and can be mirrored via a SessionStore, and the hosting guide lists observability as a production topic. However, nothing in the pack shows a first-party observability UI or a built-in trace export, so developers must wire these events into their own or third-party tooling. One community report also says the native harness displays tool-call details poorly compared with third-party session timelines. Missing for 10: a documented observability UI or tracing integration (e.g. OpenTelemetry/exporter), per-LLM-call span capture, and documentation of what the hosting guide's observability coverage actually includes.
